The allelic binding-change sign is not provided for either chain, so this comparison does not establish that the alt allele binds more.

ESR1 is the better-supported TF: it is expressed in MCF7 and the family screen reports a summit 40 bp from the variant (E14); independent ReMap evidence reports many ESR1 peaks containing the variant in MCF7, with the nearest summit 28 bp away (E26). FOXA1 is also expressed and has a reported summit 47 bp away (E13), but the evidence shown provides less direct corroboration of its own occupancy. Neither chain has a supplied allelic-binding-effect sign, and the element-to-TOX3 and disease links remain unestablished, so this is a relative advantage for A rather than support for the full mechanism.
